title: Quick Quenched Peruvian Tofu Chupe De Camarones
description: A tangy and refreshing Peruvian dish featuring tofu, perfect for a brunch mood, this low-carb friendly recipe is a twist on the traditional Chupe De Camarones, using sous-vide cooking for a glassy-jelly texture.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, puree the shrimp broth, lime juice, aji amarillo pepper, and garlic until smooth.
Strain the mixture into a bowl and discard the solids.
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the marinade and cook in the sous-vide machine for 1 hour.
Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium heat and saute the red onion until softened.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and cook for an additional minute.
To serve, place the cooked tofu in a bowl and spoon the sauteed onion and cilantro mixture over the top.
Drizzle with the sour cream and serve immediately.
